verses.text: For the one directing. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. Only toward God [is] my soul silent; from Him [is] my salvation.

verses.text: Only He [is] my Rock and my salvation, My tower; not much will I be shaken.

verses.text: Only He [is] my Rock and my salvation, my secure height; I will not be shaken.

verses.text: In God [is] my salvation and my glory, the Rock of my strength; my refuge [is] in God.
